dimensions.assessment: Affects active duty uniformed service members, veterans, their family members, and companions who travel significant distances for medical treatment.
dimensions.evidence: a covered beneficiary who must travel a significant distance to receive care or services at a Department or non-Department facility

dimensions.assessment: Provides no-cost temporary lodging access on a space-available basis and extends a pension limitation for certain hospitalized veterans.
dimensions.evidence: furnishes no-cost lodging to veterans and other eligible individuals when receiving treatment

dimensions.assessment: Extends existing pension limitations through July 31, 2033, but does not specify new federal spending amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5503(d)(7) of title 38... striking 'January 31, 2033' and inserting 'July 31, 2033'

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 of the United States Code to expand eligibility definitions for VA temporary lodging facilities.
dimensions.evidence: direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to make temporary lodging facilities... available for certain individuals on a space available basis

dimensions.assessment: Makes permanent statutory changes to Fisher House eligibility while extending a specific pension limit through 2033.

missing_information: The exact number of individuals expected to utilize space-available Fisher House lodging.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands space-available eligibility for temporary lodging at VA Fisher Houses to active duty uniformed service members, veterans' families, and others traveling for medical care, while extending a pension limitation.
